extra.doc: Generates X-Sov-Request-Id when missing, propagates an upstream-supplied id end-to-end, stamps response header. Anchors request tracing across hops.
Owns /rpc/_register plus federation, health, and introspect aggregation across the mesh.
Cascading /rpc/_batch — groups calls by destination and coalesces same-pod calls into one round trip.
Gates /rpc/_register with a shared bearer token (simple kubeadm-style join), distinct from the meshsecret HMAC gate.
Generates X-Sov-Request-Id when missing, propagates an upstream-supplied id end-to-end, stamps response header. Anchors request tracing across hops.
Cross-origin resource sharing — short-circuits OPTIONS preflight + stamps Access-Control-Allow-* response headers per Config.
Logs one line per dispatched RPC (router, method, status, duration, subject, mode).
Liveness probe at /rpc/__ping — a no-auth 200 the web client uses to detect real connectivity (the SW treats /rpc/ as NetworkOnly, so it truly hits the origin).
404s obvious vulnerability-scanner probes (.php/.env paths, /wp-, /phpmyadmin, …) before the SPA fallback serves them a 200.
Exposes the public /rpc/_introspect API catalog (opt-in: discloses the full service/method/type surface).
Serves the interactive API explorer UI at /rpc/_explorer/.
Dynamic rendering for /s/ shares: server-rendered HTML for crawlers/unfurlers, the SPA for browsers.
iCalendar (.ics) subscribe feed at /cal/<feed-token>.ics for a calendar (its own revocable token).
Model Context Protocol server at /mcp — an MCP client with a (folder-scoped) API key reads/writes its mininote folder as agent memory.
Streams hosted images at /file/<space>/<sha>.webp, gated by space membership.
Accepts a RAW image POST at /upload/<ticket> (bytes = body, name in X-Upload-Name) → verifies, stores, returns its URL.
Streams a user's note tree as a structured ZIP of markdown at /export/zip/<token> or an EPUB at /export/epub/<token>.
Global Server-Sent-Events bus at /sse/<ticket> — pushes per-account nudges (new notification) and room events (locks, viewer counts). The client refetches truth via RPC on each event.
Serves the SPA at /, with server-rendered homepage HTML for crawlers hitting exactly /.
